features.statement: Section headings are set in a high-contrast serif display face, with lowercase, sentence-style headlines ending in periods.
Typography uses a small set of three families: a geometric sans body, a serif for headings, and a script accent.
Accent color is a hot pink used for small text highlights, alongside warm yellow and orange fills.
Header is compact: small logo on the left and a single row of uppercase nav links on the right.
Hero is a two-column split with headline and buttons on the left and a single photo on the right.
Content sits inside a centered column of roughly 1080px with generous side margins.
Page is compact, a short scroll of a few distinct bands rather than a very long feed.
Posts and social content appear as text-only pastel cards with a category label, title and 'read' link, no images.
Pagination and primary actions are pill-shaped, with circular numbered chips and the current page filled.
Newsletter signup is minimal: a single rounded email field with a pill subscribe button, centered.
Social icons are small and sit inside outlined circles in a single footer row.
Promo sections are full-width tinted bands, with a two-column layout of kicker, serif title, copy and pill button beside a photo.
A dimmed photo background carries centered white text with a script kicker.
Small uppercase letter-spaced kicker labels sit above most section headings.
Announcement bar is a single thin colored strip with an underlined link.
Heading hierarchy is clean: H2 for sections, H3 for card titles, H4 for footer column labels.
Markup is lean, with real button elements, few classes and inline styles, and alt text on images.
Subtle polish: many CSS transitions, a translucent blurred header and a single soft shadow on the hero image.
Body text uses tighter line height, about 1.65 on 16px.
Document title leads with the brand name and an author byline instead of a keyword phrase.
Secondary copy is short, casual and lowercase, with friendly script kickers and personal tone.
